Our globals.css has no explicit `font-size` or `line-height` on `body` — it relies on Tailwind defaults. Need to add `font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.75;` to the body rule.

2. `img { max-width: 100%; vertical-align: middle; display: inline-block; }` is set in webflow.css but not in our globals.css. Tailwind's preflight covers `max-width: 100%` on images but not `vertical-align: middle; display: inline-block`. This is minor but worth adding.

4. `scroll-behavior: smooth` and `prefers-reduced-motion` override from Webflow inline style are already covered by `@apply scroll-smooth` on `html`, but we're missing the `prefers-reduced-motion` counterpart.

**Changes needed to globals.css:**
- Add `font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.75;` to body rule in `@layer base`
- Add `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { html { scroll-behavior: auto; } }` to match Webflow exactly
